test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"He helps the poor."

options.text: The poor are helped by him.
The poor were helped by him.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "He helps the poor."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the poor" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "helps" to "are helped" (present simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "him."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The poor are helped by him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The poor were helped by him." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The poor had been helped." – Incomplete sentence, missing the doer of the action.
 
• **Option 4: **"The poor have helped." – Incorrect structure, active voice sentence.
